symptom: X02 specified UNAPPROVED_PROTOCOL as the first denial while its test-only witness/settlement proof shapes were expressly unauthenticated. The catalog's own failure precedence requires trust/proof authenticity to be evaluated before protocol approval. The contradictory vector could teach a future verifier harness to mask missing independent attestation with a downstream protocol failure; no actual verifier or scoring path was executed.
lesson: A negative vector that deliberately combines missing independent attestation and missing protocol approval must assert the first causal trust-authenticity denial. A downstream UNAPPROVED_PROTOCOL classification is still a blocker, but must not replace or mask the earlier UNVERIFIED_WITNESS failure.
guardrail: For future verifier test catalogs, freeze the documented denial precedence and assert the expected first blocker against each fixture's independent-evidence preconditions. Keep downstream blockers separate; never manufacture a verified-positive fixture to make an expected downstream denial reachable. Preserve literal independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false in specification-only vectors.
